messages:
maria: heads-up — seeing a spike of `postproc` stalls in metering postproc over the last ~2h, invoices queueing up. /cc @devon :eyes:
chris: where are you seeing the stalls? any logs?
maria: snippet from postproc logs:
```
2026-02-24T18:12:08Z postproc[pid=7] WARN stall_detected batch=0 duration_ms=5200 route=eu-west-1
2026-02-24T18:12:09Z postproc ERROR retrying event 0x4f2f... cause=kvcache_lock_timeout
```
devon: saw something similar after the telemetry sampling tweak last week (sampling_rate=0.02). might be interacting with batching heuristics.
ana: can you paste the config change PR? we added a graceful-shed flag recently.
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/424 — envs: METER_POSTPROC_SAMPLING=0.02, POSTPROC_MAX_WAIT_MS=5000
leo: ingest-bot alert:
ingest-bot: ALERT metering.postproc.stall rate=45m: 8 spikes, avg_latency +1200ms (alert-id: mp-stall-20260224)
chris: quick q: did this correlate with yesterday's routing policy change that routes some tenants to dedicated pools?
devon: yes — routing->dedicated increased KV cache misses. postproc prefix-merge holds a lock; if sampling undercounts hot routes we end up with tiny batches that flush often -> more locking contention.
maria: immediate mitigation proposal: bump POSTPROC_MAX_WAIT_MS -> 10000 and temporarily disable the new sampling flag for 1 hour. rollout as a canary to eu-west-1.
ana: +1 but also we need dashboard changes: surface `lock_timeout` tag and per-route breakdown in the metering console. current agg hides hotspots.
chris: i'll patch canary deploy script. command i plan to run:
```
kubectl set env deploy/postproc POSTPROC_MAX_WAIT_MS=10000 METER_POSTPROC_SAMPLING=
```
devon: i'll run retained traces and a synthetic hot-route eval to reproduce locally and propose a longer-term KV cache lock redesign.
leo: if we change sampling/timeout during rollout, add a temporary metering tag so billing doesn't auto-attribute the spike to customers (meta: internal-credit=true).
maria: good call. i'll file a quick invoice-exempt ticket to avoid automated chargebacks.
ingest-bot: NOTE scheduled-canary deploy created by chris for postproc in eu-west-1 (deploy-9876)
ana: can we add a small postmortem checklist item: root cause, immediate mitigations, dashboard alerting diff, and longer-term fix (kv lock redesign + smarter batching)?
maria: thanks — running the canary now, will update.
chris: canary finished — metrics look improved so far :thumbsup:
maria: last check @18:16 UTC latency down ~40% vs peak. leaving this open until tomorrow morning to confirm.
